aicor/garmi/garmi.xml.about: The hands as their finger joints (each finger's opening in m, as the real GARMI's Franka hands report them) driving the tendon actuators; scripts/garmi_lobby_bridge.py turns the rest into the real robot's interface

custom/franka_fr3_hand/franka_fr3_hand.x.about: As franka_ros2 drives an FR3 with its hand through ros2_control: the lobby is the hardware behind topic_based_ros2_control's default topics (server/ros/fr3: launch, URDF, controllers); robot_state_publisher computes TF from the URDF

aicor/tracy/tracy.xml.about: As the real Tracy's ros2_control runs it: the lobby is the hardware behind topic_based_ros2_control (ijcai_2026_workshop's demo/tracy_roscontrol: a controller manager per arm, a relay turning their velocity commands into position targets); robot_state_publisher computes TF from iai_tracy's URDF

mujoco_menagerie/franka_emika_panda/pand.about: A real Panda can follow it (python -m real_robot --robot panda: franky on libfranka 0.9.x, for Panda System 4.2.x; real_robot/README.md); the finger joints, each finger's opening in m as the Franka hand reports it, drive the tendon actuator

mujoco_menagerie/robotstudio_so101/so101.about: A real SO-101 can follow it (python -m real_robot --robot so101; its driver is still to be written: real_robot/drivers/so101.py)
